query: What visit-note signals suggest a longer visit?

per_column.name: visit_type
per_column.rationale: Nature of visit (new acute vs follow-up vs preventive) plausibly correlates with duration but is not a component of it; a legitimate upstream predictor.

per_column.name: active_problem_count
per_column.rationale: More active problems documented plausibly drives longer visits; a distinct clinical complexity feature outside the focus.

per_column.name: clinical_severity
per_column.rationale: Severity/acuity is a patient-state variable that plausibly predicts duration without restating it.

per_column.name: critical_stabilizing_action
per_column.rationale: Actions taken during the visit correlate with time spent; borderline concurrent, but represents care intensity rather than a deterministic function of duration, so predictive signal is genuine.

per_column.name: imaging_or_diagnostic_ordered
per_column.rationale: Ordering imaging plausibly extends visit length; a separate documented activity, not a restatement of duration.

per_column.name: laboratory_test_ordered
per_column.rationale: Lab ordering is a distinct workflow signal correlated with longer visits.

per_column.name: specialist_consult_urgency
per_column.rationale: Consult urgency reflects complexity/coordination effort predictive of duration; not a component of it.

per_column.name: medication_change_type
per_column.rationale: Medication changes require discussion/reconciliation time; a legitimate distinct feature.

per_column.name: counseling_topic_type
per_column.rationale: Counseling activity plausibly lengthens visits; distinct documented content, not a restatement.

per_column.name: shared_decision_making_documented
per_column.rationale: SDM documentation reflects deliberation time; a separate signal with plausible predictive value.

per_column.name: specialist_consult_or_referral
per_column.rationale: Semantically near-duplicate of specialist_consult_urgency with overlapping categories; adds little independent signal beyond that column.

judge.rationale: Nearly all added columns are legitimate upstream/concurrent clinical-workflow variables (complexity, severity, orders, actions, counseling) that plausibly carry real predictive signal about visit duration without restating or deterministically encoding it, and none constitute post-outcome leakage of the minutes themselves. The set is coherent and clinically grounded, giving substantial predictive leverage beyond the original columns. One column (specialist_consult_or_referral) is a redundant restatement of specialist_consult_urgency, slightly diluting the set.
